summary: Frontend-only bug-fix verification for BITVERSE logo visibility. All logo instances (navbar, footer, About, hero, viewer target) now load correctly with naturalWidth=500, complete=true, and render at the required visible sizes across every page tested.
critical_code_review_comments: Navbar logo class w-14 h-14 (56px) provides clearly-recognizable book icon; visual screenshot confirms cyan book prominently displayed next to BITVERSE text.
Viewer page (/viewer/:fileId) uses w-10 h-10 (40px). Not directly tested via a real fileId to avoid triggering backend, but same LOGO_URL is used and loads at 500x500 — no broken image risk.
Consider using srcSet/loading='lazy' for footer/viewer logos as a minor perf enhancement (non-blocking).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified visually and programmatically. Screenshot at .screenshots shows the navbar logo (top-left) with the cyan book icon clearly visible next to the BITVERSE brand text on all routes. All img tags have naturalWidth=500, complete=true, and rendered clientWidths >= their respective thresholds. Hero (288px), About (128px), footer (64px), navbar (56px). No console errors.
